Chapter 752: Chapter 34: Through the Ages (8000 words, please subscribe)_2

And for those amongst the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, there was no difference between the two.

As for the main body outside the Two-dimensional World, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, it was not in a dangerous environment, and likewise, it was unhindered.

“Still can’t push it open?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was silent as he stared at the Heavenly Gate before him, frowning in deep thought.

If even with all his methods deployed, he couldn’t open the Heavenly Gate, then which of the powerhouses from the myriad tribes within this Two-dimensional World could?

“I am at the Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm, which is equivalent to the Witch Ancestor Sixty-Seventy Realms of other powerhouses from Myriad Clans. Combined with the amplification from the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Enhancement’, my strength in the short term could probably rival that between Witch Ancestor Ninety to One Hundred Realms.”

...

Lin Yuan looked at the Heavenly Gate before him, thinking to himself.

…

Below the mountain peak.

Many powerhouses from the myriad tribes finally recovered from their shock.

Soon, one of the powerhouses realized something.

That was, the Heavenly Gate before Lin Yuan, was it still not pushed open?

“What does this mean?”

“With the strength of the human ‘Blood Rain,’ can’t he push the Heavenly Gate open?”

“Impossible, if even ‘Blood Rain’ can’t push open the Heavenly Gate, how did those Witch Emperors and Witch Ancestors enter it before?”

All the powerhouses from Myriad Tribes were in an uproar, although most of them had no relationship with entering the Heavenly Gate.

But now, seeing that the Heavenly Gate, which had been seen as the hope for leaving the Two-dimensional World for over three hundred years, was nearly impossible to push open, their hearts couldn’t help but swell with a sense of desolation.

If the Heavenly Gate couldn’t be opened, then what was the point of these myriad tribes’ powerhouses madly cultivating and desperately enhancing their strength over these three hundred years?

Wouldn’t their behavior of hunting everywhere for oddities be utterly laughable?

If they collected all the oddities within the entire Two-dimensional World, but couldn’t take them out, wouldn’t it be the same as garbage?

“As strong as the human ‘Blood Rain’ is, if he can’t open the Heavenly Gate, I might as well give up on this avatar.”

One after another, the powerhouses from the myriad tribes began to fade away within the Two-dimensional World. Giving up on an avatar was equivalent to a fundamental loss, and no powerhouse was willing to bear it.

But if there really was no hope of leaving, it might be a relief to give up earlier.

At least they wouldn’t have to continue worrying and fearing within the Two-dimensional World.

…

Outside the scroll.

The complexions of the Supreme Beings were unsightly.

“The Heavenly Gate can’t be pushed open?”

“Under such circumstances, doesn’t that mean there’s no hope of leaving?”

“How is that possible? Before, the Heavenly Gate could be opened, but now it can’t?”

The Supreme Beings talked amongst themselves. They had originally deduced that the Heavenly Gate of the Two-dimensional World would be the passage connecting the inside and the outside.

But they had never expected that the Heavenly Gate could not be pushed open.

“Xia Qin…” The Supreme Beings of the Star Alliance and the Yu Clan Supreme Beings and others changed their expressions, looking towards Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Just now, to purchase the lives of the Four Divine Kings, the skinny old man, and the other six Tier 11 Perfect strong ones, they had paid a significant price to Xia Qin Supreme Being.

But now, if the Heavenly Gate couldn’t be opened, wouldn’t that mean their price was paid in vain?

Because if they couldn’t leave through the Heavenly Gate, the fate of the Four Divine Kings and other strong ones would still be death, with the only difference being whether they died in battle or of old age.

“All trades are done, how…do you plan to back out?” Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at the other Supreme Beings from Different Species, without a hint of pleasure for having the upper hand.

Because… if the Heavenly Gate couldn’t be opened, not only did it mean the fate of the Four Divine Kings and other strong ones, but Lin Yuan’s fate would be the same.

Unable to open the Heavenly Gate and trapped in the Two-dimensional World, without the ability to control the Rule of Time to slow down the flow, they would have to die in, at most, a hundred thousand to two hundred thousand years.

And a hundred thousand to two hundred thousand years in the Two-dimensional World was equivalent to just one or two thousand years in the Main Universe.

Compared to facing a fundamental loss, Xia Qin Supreme Being would rather have not had those gains.

“Gentlemen, the inability to open the Heavenly Gate is probably related to the fact that the powerhouses of Myriad Clans were absorbed into it, causing some changes to the Two-dimensional World within White Paper,” said a one-horned Supreme Being, voicing his speculation.

At these words.

The other Supreme Beings nodded slightly.

They also had similar thoughts; otherwise, why could the Witch Emperors open the Heavenly Gate before the descent of the powerhouses from Myriad Clans, and now, even the ‘Blood Rain’ of Human Civilization was blocked outside?

“Let’s wait and see.”

“There might be some other change.”

The numerous Supreme Beings continued to observe the massive ‘scroll’ from afar.

The Supreme Beings from Star Alliance and others, although they wanted to cancel the trade with Xia Qin Supreme Being, had already sent out their treasures, so it was too late for regrets.

With the strength of Human Civilization, to get those treasures back, they would have to start a full-scale war, which was almost hopeless.

Even if they started a full-scale war, it would be a case of causing substantial damage to the enemy but suffering heavy losses themselves, absolutely meaningless.

…

In the Two-dimensional World.

Lin Yuan stood in front of the Heavenly Gate but chose not to continue trying.

Since even utilizing the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Enhancement’ couldn’t move the Heavenly Gate, any further attempts would be futile.

“Could it be that this Heavenly Gate is specifically targeting me?”

Lin Yuan suddenly thought, a conjecture that seemed incredible but now needed consideration.

…

On the side of the Human Civilization Evolvers.

Xuanyuan Dua and the other Eleventh-Rank Evolvers were equally puzzled as to why the Heavenly Gate hadn’t been opened.

Just then.

A voice suddenly rang in their ears.

“Xuanyuan Dua, come here a moment.”

“Yes.” Xuanyuan Dua immediately realized that it was Lin Yuan calling her.

She swiftly headed towards the Heavenly Gate.

“Lord Xueyu…” Before the Heavenly Gate, Xuanyuan Dua bowed slightly to Lin Yuan with some restraint.

Before this day, Xuanyuan Dua certainly respected Lin Yuan, but it was merely respect; in her view, she was also an Eleventh-Rank Life, and even the fifth tier of Eleventh-Rank Life.
